clips.title: The story
paras: Syral Bladeleaf seeks help keeping her family’s busy trade supplied in Dolanaar. Her husband spends nearly all his time brewing, and fresh elixirs could ease his workload while earning the brewer uncommon herbs.

Dolanaar draws travelers, sentinels, and druids moving through Teldrassil. Syral Bladeleaf and her husband have built a flourishing herb and alchemy trade to serve them. Demand keeps her husband bent over vials and cauldrons for nearly all his hours, leaving the couple little time together.

Syral turns to passing herbalists and brewers to ease her husband’s workload. She asks for Elixirs of Lion's Strength and Minor Defense, offering freshly gathered, uncommon herbs in exchange. For a fledgling alchemist practicing beneath the Great Tree, the exchange brings a bundle of herbs and a chance to turn common forest flora into coveted regional flora.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our herb and alchemy shop is booming, but my husband spends so much time mixing potions that we never have time for each other.
If you can bring me a supply of pre-made elixirs, then I would be happy to trade with you. I have some rare herbs that you might find useful.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Do you have the elixirs to trade?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are nicely mixed. You take great care in your trade, friend, and that is important for an alchemist.
Here are your herbs, freshly gathered. May you use them well.
